an8.37:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these eight gifts of a good person.
an8.37:1.3: (1) He gives what is pure; (2) he gives what is excellent; (3) he gives a timely gift; (4) he gives what is allowable; (5) he gives after investigation; (6) he gives often; (7) while giving he settles his mind in confidence; and (8) having given, he is elated.
an8.37:1.4: These are the eight gifts of a good person.”
an8.37:2.1: He gives what is pure and excellent,
an8.37:2.2: allowable drinks and food at the proper time;
an8.37:2.4:
to fertile fields of merit,
to those who lead the spiritual life.
an8.37:3.2: having given away many material things.
an8.37:3.4: the gifts given in this way.
an8.37:4.2:
with a mind freely generous,
one intelligent and wise, rich in faith,
an8.37:4.3: is reborn in a pleasant, unafflicted world.
